title: Flashcards: Where it is official, Africa
intro: Flip each card about Africa. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: In which country is Amharic an official language?
cards.explain: Amharic is an official language of Ethiopia.

cards.front: In which country is Kinyarwanda an official language?
cards.explain: Kinyarwanda is an official language of Rwanda.

cards.front: In which country is Chichewa an official language?
cards.explain: Chichewa is an official language of Malawi.

cards.front: In which country is Rundi an official language?
cards.explain: Rundi is an official language of Burundi.

cards.front: In which country is Sango an official language?
cards.explain: Sango is an official language of Central African Republic.

cards.front: In which country is Somali an official language?
cards.explain: Somali is an official language of Somalia.

cards.front: In which countries is Southern Sotho an official language?
cards.explain: Southern Sotho is an official language of Lesotho, South Africa.

cards.front: In which countries is Swahili (macrolanguage) an official language?
cards.back: Kenya, Uganda, United Republic of Tanzania
cards.explain: Swahili (macrolanguage) is an official language of Kenya, Uganda, United Republic of Tanzania.

cards.front: In which country is Tsonga an official language?
cards.explain: Tsonga is an official language of South Africa.

cards.front: In which country is Central Atlas Tamazight an official language?
cards.explain: Central Atlas Tamazight is an official language of Morocco.

cards.front: In which country is Ndzwani Comorian an official language?
cards.explain: Ndzwani Comorian is an official language of Comoros.

cards.front: In which country is Yoruba an official language?
cards.explain: Yoruba is an official language of Nigeria.
